title: ML Model Visualizer
org: Computational Cognitive Science Researcher at SFSU RADLab
description: A web tool for stepping through applied ML models — IAC, Rumelhart-style neural networks, and other semantic memory simulations. Built to help students build intuition for how these models actually work by watching each training step run in the browser.
